query: insert into users (id,organization_id,subject,email,role,status,active,provisioning_source,tokens_valid_after) values ($1,$2,$3,$4,'member',$5,$6,'scim',case when $6 then null else now() end) on conflict (id) do update set subject=excluded.subject,email=excluded.email,role='member',status=excluded.status,active=excluded.active,provisioning_source='scim',tokens_valid_after=excluded.tokens_valid_after,updated_at=now()
